text: The uncommon reason for the conventional usage of oneness and so forth is number. It is a quality of the nine substances. It extends from oneness to the other half (i.e., up to the second half of the numerical series). Oneness is both eternal and non-eternal. That which is possessed of eternality is eternal; that which is possessed of non-eternality is non-eternal. However, duality and so forth are non-eternal in all cases. || 24 ||
